title: Emergency Response Group membership is competence-gated, so delegated voting power buys no crisis authority
content:
A.1.9.1.2.4 draws a clean line between two kinds of standing: "Aligned Delegate membership in the Emergency Response Group is not automatic based on amount of delegated SKY or Ranked Delegate status. An Aligned Delegate seeking to participate in emergency response must be reviewed and approved by Core GovOps prior to joining," which "has discretion to approve or deny... based on their assessment of the Aligned Delegate's competence and reliability."

The explicit disclaimer matters because the alternative is the system's default. Level 3 Ranked Delegate seats *are* awarded purely by delegated SKY (A.1.6.4.1.3.3), so the natural extension would be for crisis roles to follow the same ranking. This provision blocks that inference.

The reasoning turns on what each mechanism actually measures. Delegated SKY measures how much voting power holders have entrusted to a delegate — a signal about trust and, per A.1.6.4.1.3.3, a legitimate basis for budget. It says nothing about whether that delegate can diagnose a peg crisis at 3am. A.1.9.1.2.1 states what the ERG must be able to do: "diagnose a situation, suggest a short-term mitigation and act on such mitigation," plus "define the path forward for a long-term solution." That is operational capability, and it is not what delegation selects for.

So the ERG is composed by assessment rather than by market: A.1.9.1.2 describes it as "a group of Facilitators, Aligned Delegates, and Ecosystem Actors that include domain experts in different areas," with membership changeable "at the discretion of Core GovOps" (A.1.9.1.2.1) and tracked as Active Data.

The general principle is that authority to *decide* and authority to *respond* are separately conferred. A well-delegated but technically weak delegate keeps their vote and their budget, and is kept out of the war room.
description: A.1.9.1.2.4 states AD membership 'is not automatic based on amount of delegated SKY or Ranked Delegate status' and requires Core GovOps approval on competence and reliability.
